memoryRule: a timed double tap makes one painted band land at a wrong anchor and later bands reuse that wrong landing
interactionRule: a single tap only arms a short interval; a timed double-tap, Enter, Space, or the slip control commits one bounded wrong-landing event; Delete lifts the latest slip; release clears the route
representationRupture: pressure print sheet, SVG room map, and DOM cut-outs -> one continuous Canvas route whose stroke endpoints carry memory
encounterRupture: button pressure, situated attention, and traveled drag -> a temporal double tap that must arrive before the interval expires
temporalRupture: pressure register, wrong closure, and vacancy/reflow -> later geometry rebuilt from a wrong landing
mediumRupture: p5 Canvas print, inline SVG topology, and HTML/CSS layout -> deterministic Canvas 2D material route
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
